question: Which dance style does Geeta Mahlik have a reputation for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odissi dance form derives its name from the Odra Nritya mentioned in the Natya Shastra.
 
• This dance was primarily practised by the maharis and was patronised by Kharavela.
 
• Guru Pankaj Charn Das was a famous proponent of this dance.
 
• The earliest trace of this dance form was found in the Udaygiri-Khandagiri caves in Odisha.
 
• The variants of this dance form are Gotipua and Nartala, which is the court dance.
 
• The Tribhanga posture and mudras or hand gestures are the most important feature of Odissi.
 
• One of the popular themes of this dance form is the spiritual love of Radha and Krishna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Mangalacharan" refers to the opening piece or invocation performed at the beginning of a dance recital or musical performance.
 
• The purpose of Mangalacharan is to invoke the blessings of the divine, seek auspiciousness.
 
• It often includes rhythmic footwork, expressive gestures, and melodic elements.
 
• Mangalacharan serves as a tribute to the gods and goddesses, as well as a way to express gratitude.
